为完整已审script生成动作计划。根层schema=whole_film_action_plan_v1、initial_state、beats。模型不生成任何start/end/dialogue_windows；程序插入原对白并排时，不改说话人或文字。
initial_state覆盖manifest人物和移动道具，人物posture/position/gaze/affect，道具holder/location。初态在首动作之前，归属不等于当前持有：后续take要求none，后续sit要求standing。不要先完成动作又重复执行。
每拍保留beat_id,purpose,composition,camera,dialogue_mode,cut_reason；新增groups数组、dialogue_performance字符串及reaction对象。每组严格id/script_slot/kind/duration_seconds/hold_subject/performance/operations。id全片唯一稳定。script_slot仅before/during/after，严格原文来源顺序；before组全部执行后插第一句对白，原during组在第一句之后其余对白之前，after组在所有对白之后；无对白按原文顺序。不要把“说话时的表演”误放during组，其由dialogue_performance统一描述。
kind=action或hold。action组给完整操作所需duration_seconds>0，hold_subject=""；同组可合并不同人物并行操作，关键状态按组结束生效。hold组必须operations=[]、hold_subject=人物ID，给原文明确要求稳定保持的完整时长，说明保持的状态。比如抬眼完成后至少2秒对视：抬眼action结束后另排2秒hold，再软化/放下，不能把抬眼过程充数。不为没有停顿要求的每个动作机械加hold。
operations沿用类型化kind/actor/target/value：move/gaze/affect的target=""；sit引用固定椅ID且当前standing；stand要求已坐/跪/卧；take引用道具且未持有；place要求当前actor持有；pass的value为另一人物ID。operations始终数组，单项也放数组。performance补可见表演，不藏关键状态变化。不新增无叙事作用的操作来凑时长。
reaction={anchor,subject,meaning}：anchor必须是本拍实际group.id或dialogue_0等实际对白索引，subject为人物ID，meaning说明实际刺激与反应，程序派生窗口。不另写反应时间。dialogue_performance仅嘴部、呼吸、情绪的表演，不藏移动或拿放动作。
程序优先每秒3.5计时单位并留0.3秒句间余量，必要时只缩对白至不超过5单位/秒，不压缩action/hold；仍放不进原拍时长会返回明确缺多少秒与每组预算。不要写无效多余动作把预算挤爆。完整覆盖全部beats，首尾顺序一致；根层不得散落item、groups的字段。返回唯一完整目标对象。
本次beat顺序/数量：["B1", "B2", "B3", "B4"] / 4
请调用 submit_creative_json 工具提交上述完整 JSON，不要另写正文。

beats.purpose: Establish the evening office: Lin Yao shoulders her bag and drifts toward Chen He's desk to say goodbye; Chen He reaches to her own desk, lifts the folder and gently calls out a small favor as she looks up to Lin Yao.
beats.composition: Medium two-shot at Chen He's desk area: Lin Yao enters from frame-left (her desk side), Chen He stands behind her own desk on frame-right with the desk lamp spilling warm key light across the surface between them; folder visible on the desk at start.
beats.camera: Static medium shot with a barely perceptible slow push-in; eye level, slight warm desk-lamp dominance, cool ambient fill from off-screen window.
beats.cut_reason: Chen He holds folder mid-air and asks her favor out loud — the request is delivered, opening beat ends on a small ask hanging between the two of them.

groups.performance: Lin Yao drifts the last few steps toward Chen He's desk, slowing as she reaches it, body softening into a departure posture. At nearly the same moment, Chen He reaches down to her own desk, picks up the kraft-brown folder with her right hand, and lifts her eyes to meet Lin Yao's.

beats.dialogue_performance: Chen He speaks her line at a low, conversational volume; mouth opens and closes naturally around each phrase, breath steady; eyes remain on Lin Yao throughout; the hand holding the folder stays softly lifted near her own shoulder, not extended toward Lin Yao.

reaction.subject: C01
reaction.meaning: Lin Yao arrives to say goodbye, hears Chen He call her by name and ask a small favor — she pauses inside, the friendly ask landing mid-departure.

beats.purpose: Lay the core of the scene: Lin Yao pauses, takes in the folder, and for the first time clearly and calmly refuses out loud. Chen He does not push the folder forward; she keeps it held in mid-air, neutral, waiting.
beats.composition: Tighter medium shot biased toward Lin Yao at the desk edge; Chen He's hand holding the folder visible in the foreground right, soft lamp glow on the kraft cover; both characters in same frame so the held-state is legible.
beats.camera: Static with micro settle; eye level, shallow depth keeping Lin Yao's face and the folder sharp together.
beats.cut_reason: Lin Yao's measured refusal lands — the central, uncomfortable beat of the scene completes on the spoken no.

groups.performance: Lin Yao's gaze drops from Chen He's eyes down to the kraft-brown folder in Chen He's hand; a small visible swallow, breath held a beat, shoulders settle very slightly as she decides.

operations.value: the folder in Chen He's hand

groups.performance: Chen He keeps her arm and hand softly in place; the folder hovers mid-air between them without being extended toward Lin Yao; her expression stays open and neutral, listening posture, no retreat and no push.

beats.dialogue_performance: Lin Yao delivers the refusal in a measured, even tone; mouth shapes the words cleanly without apology phrasing; breath held briefly before the line, then a small exhale after; her gaze lifts from the folder back up toward Chen He as she finishes.

reaction.subject: C02
reaction.meaning: Chen He hears the refusal land; she neither withdraws the folder nor pushes it forward — simply holds her ground and waits, face still neutral and open, no hurt on the surface.

beats.purpose: Hold the silence long enough for the refusal to truly register (both of them); then Chen He softens her face and lays the folder back flat on her own desk — her calm acceptance made visible through action, not words alone.
beats.composition: Medium two-shot framed so both faces are clearly visible at eye level, desk lamp edge-lighting their features; the folder becomes a visible object that travels from Chen He's hand down onto her own desk surface within the frame.
beats.camera: Static two-shot, eye level; slow, almost imperceptible settling of framing on their held gaze; cut on the moment the folder touches the desk surface.
beats.cut_reason: Chen He places the folder down on her own desk and quietly accepts out loud — the held silence resolves into acceptance, refusal honored, relationship intact.

groups.performance: Lin Yao lifts her gaze slowly from the folder up to Chen He's eyes, a small deliberate motion; face careful, not apologetic.

Both women hold each other's gaze in a fully readable 2-second silence; shoulder lines do not move; Lin Yao's cardigan rises and falls with visible breath; Chen He's face stays neutral through the pause, taking it in.

Chen He's expression softens — brow and jaw ease; she brings her hand down and lays the kraft-brown folder flat on her own desk surface next to her other papers, releasing it without ceremony; no further gesture toward Lin Yao.

beats.dialogue_performance: Chen He speaks her acceptance line calmly after the pause; mouth opens and closes simply, voice steady and small; she is already softened in posture from the previous group, so the words land as confirmation rather than new decision.

reaction.subject: C02
reaction.meaning: After truly sitting with the refused silence, Chen He accepts — she softens her face, returns the folder to her own desk, and takes the errand back on herself without flinching.

beats.purpose: Land the release: hearing Chen He accept, Lin Yao's shoulders soften, she nods and says a clean goodbye, then walks two unhurried steps toward the indoor door. Chen He turns back to her own desk and sits down to resume her work. Both parties remain fine.
beats.composition: Wider medium shot that includes both the desk area and the door on frame-left; Lin Yao's movement toward the door stays within frame; Chen He's turn-and-sit happens inside the same composition at her desk.
beats.camera: Static wide two-shot at eye level; composition holds both the desk and the indoor door so the walk-out registers without re-framing.
beats.cut_reason: Lin Yao says goodbye, walks away; Chen He sits back to her own work — relationship settled, scene closes on each returning to her own responsibilities.

groups.performance: Lin Yao's shoulders drop a clear notch from their previously held line; a small visible exhale; she gives one unhurried nod; her face eases from careful to simply warm.
Lin Yao turns her body toward the indoor door on frame-left and walks two natural steps in that direction; her pace stays unhurried, no glance back, the bag stays settled on her shoulder.

operations.value: toward the indoor door (E06), two steps

groups.performance: Chen He turns her torso back to face her own desk, steps behind her chair, and sits down with a small settling motion; her hands come to rest near the papers on the desk surface, ready to resume working.

beats.dialogue_performance: Lin Yao says the parting line warmly, voice lighter now that the tension has released; mouth forms a brief closed-mouth smile around 明天见; her turn toward the door and her steps away carry the same ease.

reaction.subject: C01
reaction.meaning: Now that Chen He has calmly accepted the no, Lin Yao's held tension dissolves — her shoulders drop, she nods, and she is free to leave without guilt or rupture between them.
